# Subtlety Rogue — Raid (group)

[Rogue](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Subtlety

**✅ Recommended** for raid (the best rogue spec here, or within 3% of it).

**[Subtlety — Raid](../research/raid/builds/subtlety-ml-raid.md)** (12/8/31) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/rogue/60/00530301-320003-325230031301001151-12)

> 🔬 Derived build: found by this project's machine-learning search over every legal build of the spec in the community's raid simulator (raid BiS gear, then raced against the spec's builds); it beat the hand-made build (Subtlety — Hemorrhage). A model of the beta, to check at launch.

## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Premeditation**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Slice and Dice**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Garrote**: keep it on the target (timing: see below)
2. **Vanish** when Garrote is not on the target (timing: see below); no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
3. **Preparation** when Vanish is on cooldown
4. **Shank** (timing: see below)
5. **Premeditation** when you have 3 or fewer combo points; no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
6. **Death Mark** when you have 4 or more combo points
7. **Rupture**: keep it on the target, when you have 3 or more combo points (timing: see below)
8. **Ghostly Strike** when Garrote has under 4 seconds left (timing: see below)
9. **Hemorrhage** (timing: see below)

Between these, your white swings do the rest.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

Subtlety in a raid is a **Death Mark** rotation: **Hemorrhage** and **Shank** build combo points, **Garrote** and **Rupture** stay on the boss, **Slice and Dice** stays up, and 4 or more points go into **Death Mark**, which stores part of your damage and deals it a second time. The list never casts **Eviscerate**. It is the official simulator's own rogue rotation (since 2026-11-20, when it ran 0.2-0.4% ahead of ours on this build); the conditions it names (the lines marked "timing: see below") are explained here. In a 3-minute raid fight: **Hemorrhage** 39 casts, **Shank** 17, **Death Mark** 14, **Slice and Dice** 9, **Rupture** 8, **Garrote** 7, **Ghostly Strike** 6; white swings 31% of the damage, **Death Mark** 22%, **Garrote**, **Rupture** and **Hemorrhage** 10% each.

**Why it works**

- **Death Mark** is your finisher: 25 energy, a 10-second cooldown, at 4 or more combo points whenever it is ready. For 6 seconds it stores a portion of the damage your attacks deal the target per combo point, **Garrote** and **Rupture** damage at twice the rate, then deals what it stored, up to a maximum your attack power and crit chance raise; **Coup de Grace** adds 20% to its damage and storage rate. At 5 points, with it on cooldown and **Rupture** and **Slice and Dice** up, the list waits for it (its **Eviscerate** line is for builds without the talent).
- **Ghostly Strike** lets your next **Garrote** within 7 seconds skip stealth, so **Garrote** stays up all fight: the strike when **Garrote** has 4 seconds or less left (or is off), then **Garrote** as soon as it is off, both below 5 combo points ("Current Points less than 5"). "Dirty Deeds Known": with **Dirty Deeds**, **Garrote** works from the front, so the strike goes from any side. **Blood Splatter** makes **Garrote** last 27 seconds, longer than the strike's 20-second cooldown; **Dirty Deeds** takes 20 energy off it, **Initiative** adds a second combo point and **Opportunity** 20% damage.
- **Rupture** goes on whenever it is off and you have 3 or more points, but not in the last 6 seconds ("Fight About to End"), where it would outlast the boss; "Expose - Prevent Other Finishers" matters only with the Expose Armor switch on (it is off: see below). **Serrated Blades** adds 30% to it and lets your attacks ignore 9% of armor, **Hemorrhage** adds 15% to **Rupture** and **Garrote** for 15 seconds, and **Blood Splatter** gives **Rupture** 6 more seconds.
- **Slice and Dice** (30% attack speed, 45% longer with **Improved Slice and Dice**) goes back up as soon as it drops, with any points you have, after **Death Mark** and a missing **Rupture**, and not in the last 6 seconds. While it is up, the list lets the simulator use your trinket and a Goblin Sapper Charge.
- **Hemorrhage** is the builder (30 energy with **Efficient Strikes**; 100% weapon damage with the simulated set's sword, 145% with a dagger), below 5 points. While **Garrote** has under 8 seconds left (or is off) the list holds it unless you have 75 energy or more ("In Danger of Energy Capping"), which keeps the 70 energy for **Ghostly Strike** (40) and the next **Garrote** (30). **Shank** costs 5 energy, gives back 25 and, with 5 points in **Boot Knife**, adds 2 combo points ("Boot Knife Known"): whenever it is ready, at 3 or fewer points and 80 energy or less.
- **Premeditation** adds 2 points before the pull, then on its 2-minute cooldown at 3 or fewer points (its Forever tooltip asks for no stealth). **Vanish** opens a **Garrote** a second into the fight: it goes when **Garrote** is off and you have its energy and fewer than 5 points ("Use Vanish for Damage" is a switch the list keeps on; "SnD Fall Imminent" never holds: its switch is off). **Preparation** follows as soon as **Vanish** is on cooldown and finishes your other rogue cooldowns, so **Premeditation** returns at once and **Vanish** waits for a **Garrote** that drops later. Thistle Tea, an item, goes once at 25 energy or less, below 3 points, while **Death Mark** is on the boss.

**Caveats**

- The **Garrote** after **Vanish** needs stealth, and damage you take breaks it: if something hits you right after **Vanish**, the next **Ghostly Strike** opens the **Garrote** instead.
- Almost all of this works from the front: **Hemorrhage**, **Ghostly Strike**, **Shank**, **Death Mark**, **Rupture**, and **Garrote** with **Dirty Deeds**. **Ambush** and **Backstab** need a dagger and you behind the target; the list casts neither (switches it keeps off).
- The numbers are a full raid: every raid buff and debuff, Sunder Armor and Expose Armor on the boss from others, a shaman's Windfury Totem in your group (8% of your damage), Instant Poison on the main hand and Deadly Poison on the off hand (3% each).
- Subtlety has no cleave: on adds, stay on the kill target, and do not **Rupture** a target that dies within a few seconds.

**When to change it**

- Without Sunder Armor or another rogue's Expose Armor on the boss (a small group, a dungeon), keep **Expose Armor** up yourself. The list's switch for it ("Use Expose Armor") is off here; on, it puts **Expose Armor** first at 5 points whenever it is missing or has 16 seconds or less left, and holds **Rupture** and **Slice and Dice** until it is back. An earlier training-dummy search, on the rotation used before 2026-11-20, measured about 2.5% from it.
- The simulator starts every fight out of stealth ("Start In Stealth" is off). In the game you can start in **Stealth** and open with **Garrote** at the pull; the list's switch for that opener was not simulated.
- If you pull threat, **Feint** (20 energy, 10-second cooldown) lowers it by a large amount.
